title: Consideration of electromagnetic wave interference on microorganism inactivation on reflective surfaces
task: Quantify electromagnetic wave interference effects on microbial inactivation near reflective surfaces
key_results: Thermal rise ΔT near metallic walls is 1–2 orders of magnitude lower than interior (ΔT < 1°C vs. 30–100°C); UV-C inactivation curves show saturation tails due to interference minima providing pathogen refugia
comments: While mechanistically sound, the practical impact on sterilization efficiency depends heavily on surface geometry and field uniformity, which may vary substantially across real-world applications.

model_io.model: UV-C interference model on metallic surfaces
Microwave thermal model in domestic oven cavity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wave interference creates spatially stable minima of exposure near reflective surfaces that harbor pathogens
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: saturation tails in UV-C curves and thermal imaging showing persistent minima at walls

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microwave thermal inactivation near walls is severely compromised compared to bulk exposure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ΔT near wall < 1°C vs. 30–100°C in interior (1–2 orders of magnitude difference)

title: Single-cell technologies in mRNA cancer vaccines
task: Review single-cell technologies for optimizing mRNA cancer vaccine development
key_results: Single-cell profiling enables identification of immune cell subsets, intercellular communication networks, and therapy resistance mechanisms in tumor microenvironment
comments: This is a perspective/review paper lacking quantitative experimental results; it provides a framework rather than novel mechanistic discoveries, limiting its impact on specific therapeutic advancement.

title: RBM15 impairs Hepatic Mitochondria and β-Oxidation through m6A-dependent degradation of MCM3 mRNA
task: Elucidate m6A-mediated regulation of hepatic mitochondrial dysfunction in diabesity
key_results: MCM3 overexpression improved mitochondrial function and β-oxidation; RBM15/YTHDF2 complex accelerates MCM3 mRNA decay via m6A modification
comments: The mechanistic link between m6A regulation and NRF2/KEAP1 signaling is interesting, though the relative contribution of competitive inhibition versus direct MCM3-mediated effects warrants further dissection.

hypotheses.hypothesis: MCM3 downregulation impairs hepatic mitochondrial function in diabesity
hypotheses.result: MCM3 overexpression restored mitochondrial function and β-oxidation

hypotheses.hypothesis: RBM15 promotes MCM3 mRNA degradation via m6A-YTHDF2 axis
hypotheses.result: RBM15 overexpression accelerated m6A-YTHDF2-mediated MCM3 decay; RBM15 knockdown benefits were MCM3-dependent

title: A lightweight, integrated generative AI assistant for accelerated early-stage drug discovery on constrained-resource hardware
task: Democratizing generative AI-driven drug discovery on consumer-grade hardware
key_results: LSTM+SELFIES model achieves training loss reduction from 2.15 to 1.19; toxicity classifier AUC of 0.790; generates novel drug-like molecules (mean LogP 2.04) with 93% infrastructure cost reduction
comments: Comprehensive end-to-end pipeline with strong engineering contribution, though validation on prospective synthesis and biological testing would elevate clinical relevance.

model_io.model: LSTM generative model with SELFIES tokenization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lightweight generative models on consumer GPUs can match enterprise-scale drug discovery workflows
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; validation loss 1.43 and weighted AUC 0.790 demonstrate reliable convergence on GTX 1650 hardware

hypotheses.hypothesis: SELFIES tokenization ensures 100% syntactic validity in generated molecules
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; all generated compounds possess valid drug-like characteristics

title: Reinforcement learning for treatment decision-making in sepsis: a scoping review
task: Evaluating reinforcement learning for sepsis treatment decision support
key_results: 72 retrospective studies reviewed, 80.6% using MIMIC database; RL policies outperformed clinicians in many cases but evaluation rigor remains uncertain
comments: Critical gap identified: lack of prospective validation and standardized evaluation metrics limits clinical translation despite promising offline results.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RL-derived sepsis treatment policies outperform standard clinical approaches
hypotheses.result: Supported in retrospective studies, but evaluation validity uncertain due to methodological heterogeneity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vasopressor and fluid management are primary targets for RL optimization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; majority of studies focused on these interventions versus antibiotics, corticosteroids, or ventilation

title: Advancing FAIR data towards comparable, organized, predictive AI-ready data for community validation
task: Establishing FAIR + COPE framework for AI-ready biological data integration and validation
key_results: Framework extends FAIR principles with Comparable, Organized, Predictive, Engaged components; enables meta-analysis across heterogeneous datasets with iterative community validation
comments: Prescriptive framework with limited quantitative metrics; concrete benchmarks on data harmonization efficiency and prediction improvement across domains would substantiate the COPE additions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAIR + COPE enhances data interoperability and predictive model generalizability versus FAIR alone
hypotheses.result: Supported conceptually through use cases; quantitative comparative validation pending

hypotheses.hypothesis: Iterative community-driven updates reduce stale annotations and propagation of incorrect relationships in AI systems
hypotheses.result: Proposed mechanism; empirical validation across reference resources required

title: Unsteady boundary-layer flow and radiative heat transfer over a deformable stretching cylinder with transpiration and slip: cross-validated Akbari-Ganji and finite-element solutions
task: Unsteady boundary-layer flow and radiative heat transfer over deformable stretching cylinder with transpiration/slip
key_results: Suction (S=0.7) increases skin friction 3.1× relative to blowing; unsteadiness (A=1.0) amplifies wall shear 61% and heat transfer 107%; compact correlations achieve R²=0.9996 (skin friction) and R²=0.991 (Nusselt)
comments: Cross-validation between AGM and FEM within 0.5–1.2% is excellent; the empirical Prandtl exponent (0.55) is problem-specific and rightly not claimed as universal.

model_io.model: Finite-Element Method (FEM) with quadratic Lagrange elements

inputs: parametric simulation data (S, λ, R_d, θ_w, A, Pr)
outputs: compact correlations for skin friction and Nusselt number

hypotheses.hypothesis: AGM and FEM solutions agree to within 0.5–1.2% for skin friction and Nusselt number
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via cross-validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Suction amplifies skin friction and Nusselt number relative to blowing
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; S=0.7 suction increases skin friction 3.1× and Nusselt 74%

hypotheses.hypothesis: Unsteadiness synergizes with suction to enhance wall shear and heat transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; A=1.0 with strong suction amplifies wall shear 61% and heat transfer 107%

title: A quantum-classical hybrid framework for optimal energy storage systems planning
task: Quantum-classical hybrid framework for optimal energy storage systems siting and sizing
key_results: Two-stage framework separates binary siting (quantum QUBO reformulation + stochastic sampling) from continuous sizing (classical SOCP); achieves grid-standard accuracy vs. industry classical solvers on IonQ Forte hardware
comments: Practical approach acknowledging NISQ limitations; the 'quantum sieve' concept for generating diverse candidate sites is conceptually sound, though current hardware latencies and state-preparation overlap remain critical bottlenecks.

outputs: stochastic sample of candidate site sets

model_io.model: Classical SOCP convex solver (Stage II: sizing & operation)
inputs: candidate site sets from Stage I

hypotheses.hypothesis: Quantum stochastic sampling explores candidate site combinations more diversely than classical single-point methods
hypotheses.result: Supported conceptually; experiments show grid-standard accuracy with potential for overlooked solutions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-stage decomposition (binary siting + continuous sizing) reduces computational burden while maintaining physical feasibility
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; two-stage approach ensures SOCP feasibility, though NISQ latencies limit practical speedup

title: Development and validation of a core competency framework for professional tennis coaches in China
task: Developing and validating a core competency framework for professional tennis coaches
key_results: Five-dimensional competency model (17 categories) identified: Situational Judgment, Professional Integration, Digital-Oriented Coordination, Growth Orientation, Humanistic Guidance; validated on 500 survey responses
comments: Mixed-methods approach is rigorous, but the framework's cultural specificity to China may limit international generalization without empirical cross-validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Five core competency dimensions are necessary and sufficient for professional tennis coaches in China
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through structural validation on 500 responses

title: Quantifying opinion homophily in online social networks from a bounded confidence perspective
task: Quantifying opinion homophily in social networks via bounded confidence model
key_results: Users' interaction neighborhoods are significantly more concentrated in opinion space than chance; asymmetric tolerance ranges typically favor locally mainstream positions over radical ones
comments: Empirical study bridging sentiment analysis with bounded confidence theory; interpretation of asymmetry direction is insightful but causality remains unclear.

model_io.model: Network interaction analysis (reply-based and follow-based ties)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Users form homophilic neighborhoods in opinion space under bounded confidence constraints
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; interaction neighborhoods significantly more opinion-concentrated than expected by chance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Asymmetric tolerance ranges exist and favor mainstream positions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; asymmetry typically directed toward locally mainstream rather than radical/opposing positions

title: Escape-induced temporally correlated noise driven crossover in growth kinetics and universality class
task: Identify universality class crossover in thin-film growth driven by temporally correlated noise
key_results: Sharp dynamical crossover from VLDS scaling (early-stage) to noise-dominated α-Sn/β-Sn coexistence (late-stage); adatom escape identified as microscopic origin of temporal noise correlations
comments: Elegant experimental confirmation of KPZ framework predictions, though the mechanistic link between escape events and macroscopic noise structure remains somewhat phenomenological.

model_io.model: Sn thin-film growth on Sb-doped MnBi2Te4

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporally correlated noise from adatom escape drives universality class crossover
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via MD simulations and morphological observations showing transition from island to cluster-nucleation regime

title: Imaging of gate-controlled suppression of superconductivity via the Meissner effect
task: Image gate-controlled suppression of Meissner effect in superconducting nanowires
key_results: Gate control of supercurrents (GCS effect) manifests as suppression of Meissner screening; nanoscale spatial imaging reveals quasiparticle dynamics consistent with hot-spot model
comments: Novel use of NV magnetometry to probe superconducting condensate properties, though the mechanism remains incompletely understood at the microscopic level.

model_io.model: Niobium superconducting islands with gate electrode

hypotheses.hypothesis: Joule heating or electric field effect causes GCS suppression
hypotheses.result: Rejected; observations incompatible with these mechanisms, supporting quasiparticle generation model

title: Rotational wobble effects on equilibrium structure and Floquet stability in the circular restricted three body problem
task: Model equilibrium structure and stability in circular restricted three-body problem with rotational wobble
key_results: Rotational wobble introduces time-dependent equilibrium displacements analyzable via perturbation theory; cumulative trajectory deviations reach 10^5–10^6 m over extended mission durations for Sun–Earth system
comments: Physically motivated perturbation with potential practical impact, though the magnitude of effects depends sensitively on wobble amplitude and integration period.

model_io.model: Perturbed circular restricted three-body problem with rotational wobble

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rotational wobble induces systematic modifications to libration point stability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Floquet analysis reveals moderate but systematic destabilization near libration regions
